name: SPIN TO WIN!

boost.name: Spin Cycle
effect: Advance up to 2 spaces.
HIT: You may move the opponent 1 space in any direction.
AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 以Cecilia的代表口號「Spin to Win!」命名。極高速的旋轉攻擊，命中後可操控對手位置並取得先機，象徵她總是能靠速度與技巧扭轉局勢。

name: ImmerScreen

boost.name: System Override
effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put any of them on the top of your deck, and the rest on the bottom.
BEFORE: Choose a Boost in play. It now affects you instead of its controller.
AFTER: Draw a card.
description: 來自她獨特的「Immersions」系列直播——透過技術能力改變遊戲畫面與規則。這張牌展現她作為程式高手的操控力，能奪取對手的增益效果並建立手牌優勢。

name: Ancient Automaton

boost.name: Eternal Mechanism
effect: +1 Armor.
+1 Guard.
Stun Immunity.
AFTER: Add this card to your Gauge at the end of the Strike.
description: 呼應她「古代自動人偶」的設定。遠古製作的機械身軀賦予她超凡的耐久力，此牌兼具防禦與資源回收功能，如同她永不停歇的機械核心。

name: Tea Time

boost.name: Fresh Brew
effect: Gain 2 life.
HIT: Discard any number of cards from your hand, then draw that many cards.
description: 以她最喜愛的紅茶（🍵）為主題。茶杯是她的代表emoji，此牌代表她在戰鬥中小憩品茶、重整旗鼓的能力，透過捨棄與抽牌來靈活調度戰術。

name: Wind-Up

boost.name: Loading...
effect: At the start of each of your turns, +1 Power (max of +3).
HIT: Add the top card of your deck to your Gauge.
description: 靈感來自她3D披露直播同名主題曲。上發條的意象完美契合自動人設，此牌象徵她逐漸加速、累積力量，隨著戰鬥進行越戰越強的成長曲線。

name: Immergination

boost.name: Creative Spark
effect: Search your deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
HIT: Your opponent discards a card from their hand at random.
description: 以粉絲創作標籤 #Immergination 命名。Cecilia以創造力著稱——從程式設計到音樂創作無一不精。此牌搜尋牌庫展現她的巧思，同時干擾對手以維持創造者的優勢。

name: Cello Suite No.1

boost.name: Presto
effect: Strike.
If you win the Strike, draw a card.
HIT: You may spend any amount of Force. For each Force spent, push the opponent 1 space.
description: 取材自她出道自我介紹的背景音樂——巴哈《無伴奏大提琴組曲第一號》。她擅長小提琴，音樂攻擊優雅而致命，能在極遠距離壓制並逐退對手。

name: ABOVE BELOW

boost.name: Dichotomy
effect: Gain 2 life.
Draw a card.
HIT: You may move the opponent to any space.
AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 以她的出道原創單曲命名。歌名象徵上下、陰陽的二元對立，此牌賦予她完全掌控戰場位置的能力，展現她作為古老存在的絕對支配力。

name: CCGG MADNESS

boost.name: Brainrot Duo
effect: Strike.
You may add a copy of a card from your discard to your hand.
HIT: The opponent discards cards from the top of their deck equal to the damage dealt.
AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 與Gigi Murin的雙人原創曲暨3D LIVE。與Gigi卡組中的同名卡對應，從Cecilia的視角強調牌組破壞與節奏壓制，呼應她作為理性吐槽役的控場風格。

name: RENEGADE

boost.name: Against the World
effect: +3 Power.
Stun Immunity.
Ignore Guard.
Ignore Armor.
HIT: Your opponent discards their entire hand.
description: 以她出道一周年原創曲命名。RENEGADE代表叛逆者——呼應她從永恆服務中解放、選擇追隨自我意志的角色弧線。作為最強終結技，無視一切防禦並清空對手手牌。
